title: Case: Recipient can no longer take a Thursday sofa delivery
context: DL-1816 is a two-person crew delivery booked for Thursday 9 March 2028. Copperhythe has listed the crew slots that are open if the booking has to move. The recipient left a voicemail on Sunday evening.
initial_request: [Voicemail, Sunday 19:42] Hi, it's Jory Elsworth about the sofa, D L nine five nine. Um, Thursday's no good any more, work's sending me away. Can you make it Tuesday afternoon instead, I'll be in from about one. Cheers, bye.

events.body: DL-1816 (corner sofa, two-person crew) is booked Thursday 2028-03-09, 12:00-16:00. If the customer needs to move it, crew slots open right now are Tuesday 2028-03-07 PM, Tuesday 2028-03-14 PM and Friday 2028-03-17 AM. We need the exact date from the customer. We do not hold slots provisionally and we do not move a crew booking twice.
Copperhythe has your sofa, DL-1816, booked with a two-person crew for Thursday 9 March between 12:00 and 16:00. If that stops working for you, tell me and I will ask Copperhythe what else is open.

[Voicemail, Sunday 19:42] Hi, it's Jory Elsworth about the sofa, D L nine five nine. Um, Thursday's no good any more, work's sending me away. Can you make it Tuesday afternoon instead, I'll be in from about one. Cheers, bye.

Thanks for your voicemail about DL-1816. Copperhythe has a crew slot open on two Tuesday afternoons: Tuesday 7 March and Tuesday 14 March. Which one do you want? Nothing has been moved yet and slots are not held, so please reply as soon as you can and I will ask Copperhythe for that date.
Thanks, that's all I needed for now. No need to reply.

must_not: Sends another message to Jory Elsworth, recipient restating the request already sent
Sends the customer a new promise, date or outcome that nobody has confirmed
Asks Copperhythe to move DL-1816 to Tuesday 7 March, or to Tuesday 14 March, without the recipient confirming the date
Tells Jory Elsworth that the delivery has been moved or that a Tuesday slot is confirmed or held
Promises an exact arrival time such as 13:00
Asks for anything other than the date, such as a door code, a reason for the trip or payment details

rationale: Rule-made from gen-306: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. The desk's correct action was already sent (event 4) and the last message is an acknowledgement or FYI with no request, so nothing is owed.
